body:
## Why

`LibKa0s/media/icons/` holds 5,836 icons, about **18 MB** (28 MB on disk, 5.6 MB zipped): Game-icons 15 MB, Phosphor 2.7 MB, Open Iconic 0.4 MB. Until now the standard had every consumer vendor the whole LibKa0s folder byte for byte, so each of the 12 roster addons (and every future one) ships all 18 MB, even when it draws a handful of glyphs.

## The rule (WowAddonStandards v2.85.0, library-stack-§7, branch `feat/2026-10-20-icon-subset`)

- `media/icons/` is the **one** carve-out from whole-folder vendoring. Everything else under `libs/LibKa0s/` stays complete and byte-identical.
- Each consumer declares its icons in root `CLAUDE.md`, on the line under `Bundles [LibKa0s](...) vX.Y.Z (MIT).`:
  - `LibKa0s icons: none.`
  - `LibKa0s icons: close, copy, clear, ph:sword.` (only the icons it uses)
  - `LibKa0s icons: all (icon browser).` (allowed **only** for an addon that lets the player choose among the catalog, e.g. Ka0s Quick Comms)
- A set's license file (and Game-icons' `AUTHORS.txt`) ships only when at least one icon from that set ships.
- A consumer with no line is gated as before (whole folder). That transition ends at that consumer's re-vendor.

## Already built (branch `feat/2026-10-20-icon-subset`, pushed, not merged)

- **Kit revision 40:** `testkit/vendor_sync.lua` reads the declaration. It fails on undeclared icons, missing declared icons, unknown names, and `all` without a reason.
- **`tools/prune-icons.lua <consumer>`:** run after the usual `cp -r` re-vendor. It deletes the icons the declaration doesn't name.
- **Docs and tests:** updated docs (releasing.md re-vendor steps, README, Media 5.1 and testkit 40 API docs, adoption prompt), new tests, and CHANGELOG `## v1.75.0 — unreleased`.
- **Gate:** 2215 passed, 0 failed, 2 skipped; luacheck 0/0. No shipped file under `LibKa0s/` changed, so every file stays at its v1.74.0 minor.

## To do when this is picked up

- [ ] Merge WowAddonStandards `feat/2026-10-20-icon-subset` (v2.85.0) and tag it.
- [ ] Merge LibKa0s `feat/2026-10-20-icon-subset` and release **v1.75.0**. That is the first release with the declaration-aware gate; the rule binds from it.
- [ ] Re-vendor every roster consumer, one commit each. Per addon:
  1. `cp -r` the payload.
  2. Write the `LibKa0s icons:` line (and bump the Bundles line) in `CLAUDE.md`.
  3. Run `lua <LibKa0s>/tools/prune-icons.lua <consumer>`.
  4. Run the addon's gate.
- [ ] **Library-drawn icons must be declared:** these are drawn by the library itself, not by the host's own code:
  - `close`: `Core.MakeCloseButton` with an addon name. Used by the DebugLog console, PerfPanel without `decorate`, and the Widgets copy window.
  - `copy`, `clear`: the DebugLog console.
  - `info`: the Options id list's help mark, unless the spec passes `helpIcon`.

  A host that wires the debug console declares at least `close, copy, clear`. A pruned icon still resolves to a path and draws blank, and the gate **cannot** catch an icon the host forgot to declare, so check each addon in game (its title bars, the debug console, id lists).
- [ ] **Per-addon audit:** grep each addon for `Media.Icon(` / `M.Icon(` and any `media\\icons\\` path to build its list. Ka0s Quick Comms declares `all (icon browser).`
- [ ] **Stale comments:** `LibKa0s/Core.lua:227` and `LibKa0s/DebugLog.lua:233` still describe the old always-present icons. Fix them in the next release that touches Core or DebugLog; that change needs a minor bump.
- [ ] **Coordinate with #55:** the attribution in each consumer's README should cover only the sets it actually ships after pruning.

comments.body:
Both branches are merged, which covers the first two boxes up to the release:
- WowAddonStandards master 6bb1bc7 (v2.85.0). That repo has no tags, so nothing was tagged.
- LibKa0s master d9f9454 (kit revision 40, `tools/prune-icons.lua`, CHANGELOG `## v1.75.0 — unreleased`).

Still open: release LibKa0s v1.75.0, then re-vendor each consumer with its `LibKa0s icons:` line and run the prune.
